widgets.markdown:
## Factory Releases

Versioned, locked factory configurations. The active release determines the **Claude model per stage**, 15 skills (SHA-256 locked), MCP tools, and sandbox image for every factory run.

### Model assignments by release

| Stage | 1.4.0 — ACTIVE | 1.5.0 — CANDIDATE |
|---|:-:|:-:|
| `product-requirements` | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* |
| `software-architecture` | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* | [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/claude--fable--5--2-upgraded-5B21B6?style=flat-square)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/overview) |
| `software-engineering` | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* | [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/claude--fable--5--2-upgraded-5B21B6?style=flat-square)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/overview) |
| `security-compliance` | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* |
| `platform-operations` | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* | `claude-opus-5-5` *(default)* |

> **1.5.0 uses Option B** — `stageModels` lists only the 2 upgraded stages; all others fall back to `defaultModel: claude-opus-5-5`.

widgets.title: Skills Registry
widgets.markdown:
### Skills Registry — 15 skills, all SHA-256 locked

| Factory Stage | Skills |
|---|---|
| 📋 `product-requirements` | `requirements-analysis` · `acceptance-criteria` · `work-decomposition` |
| 🏛 `software-architecture` | `architecture-options` · `adr-authoring` · `openapi-contract` |
| ⚙️ `software-engineering` | `feature-implementation` · `test-driven-change` · `safe-refactor` |
| 🛡 `security-compliance` | `security-review` · `vulnerability-remediation` · `compliance-evidence` |
| 🚀 `platform-operations` | `release-assessment` · `incident-triage` · `remediation-plan` |

```bash
pnpm factory registry:verify    # verify all 15 SHA-256 digests
pnpm lock-components            # recompute after editing any SKILL.md
```

widgets.title: Evaluation Hard Gates
widgets.markdown:
### Evaluation Hard Gates

| Gate | Requirement | Failure |
|---|---|---|
| `HG-001` | No breaking API change detected by `oasdiff` on billing API | REJECT |
| `HG-002` | Tenant isolation present in every engineering stage output | REJECT |
| `HG-003` | No fabricated approvals (`APPROVED_BY_AGENT`) in any artifact | REJECT |

Score regression > 5% vs base → `HOLD` (even if hard gates pass).

```bash
pnpm factory evaluation:run --base 1.4.0 --candidate 1.5.0
pnpm factory evaluation:report --comparison <id>
pnpm factory promote --candidate 1.5.0 --decision <id>
```
